message.content: {"summary":"You have written a coherent, well-structured report with a clear recommendation not to ship, supported by relevant NHS and Volkswagen cases and the EACE. Your strongest areas are your identification of harm to end-users and the logical flow from arguments to conclusion. The main areas to strengthen are the evidence behind the arguments for shipping, analysis of the decision threshold, referencing accuracy and language precision.","next_steps":["Analyse the decision threshold in the scenario: explain when shipping might be acceptable (data-loss issues) versus when it is not (physical harm), and how Rachel should decide between them.","Strengthen the arguments for shipping with reputable external evidence and rebut them directly. Also show clearly how the NHS data-loss cases link to Rachel's physical-harm defects, rather than assuming the link.","Format all references consistently and completely (including authors and URLs for [3] and a corrected [4]), correct the language errors, and add at least one figure or table to support your discussion."],"criteria":{"C1":"You identify key ethical issues, including harm to end-users, professional responsibility and quality versus business pressure, and you name the main stakeholders in your introduction. To reach Excellent, briefly explore the industry context, link the issues more explicitly to specific engineering design practice, and develop each stakeholder's interests rather than only naming them.","C2":"You present arguments for and against shipping and reach a clear conclusion. To move up, give the arguments for shipping more depth by supporting them with evidence rather than opinion, and rebut them directly. Extend your recommendations beyond Rachel and her company to include the health department and the chip contract company.","C3":"Your report follows a logical sequence (for, against, ethical path, conclusion, recommendations), which makes the argument easy to follow and supports your conclusion on harm and professional integrity. To reach Excellent, systematically rebut the arguments for shipping and give all stakeholders an equally thorough analysis.","C4":"You use four references, including relevant case studies and the EACE, to support your points. Some claims are weakly supported: the Apple/Samsung/Google claim is not backed by the CNBC source you cite, and most arguments for shipping lack external evidence. Add quantitative evidence and make sure each source supports the specific claim it is attached to.","C5":"Your report includes the required sections and is generally readable. Correct the language errors, including the broken sentences, and check your word choice. Reference [3] needs an author and URL, and reference [4] needs reformatting. Adding figures or tables would strengthen your visual support."}}
